name: old-tool-output-elided
about: Web search on, build tools and auto-compaction off (compaction is WP 6.2), a small context (6000 tokens, 1000 for the reply). Two turns each read five long search results, a third is plain; before the fourth the history is past TOOL_ELIDE_THRESHOLD (0.6), so the first turn's search result is elided to a note (the last two turns are kept) and the session log takes the new history as a replace.
